title: Peek — Carrier scrapers
description: Starts with the carrier goals, from the app database's metrics schema (PostgreSQL): the errors readers see, the tracking quality and the reliance on universal trackers. Then the scrapers' lookups, steps, refreshes and status mapping, from the app's Prometheus metrics. See docs/OBSERVABILITY.md.

list.name: Deploys
list.textFormat: A deploy or restart; counters start again

target.rawSql:
select time, 'Scraper ' || scraper as text, 'scraper' as tags
from metrics.releases
where scraper_changed and $__timeFilter(time)
order by time

select time, 'Peek ' || app as text, 'peek' as tags
from metrics.releases
where not scraper_changed and $__timeFilter(time)
order by time

panels.title: Parcels answered directly
panels.description: Share of the parcels being tracked with a scan whose latest answer came from a carrier's adapter: their own carrier's, or another carrier's after a handoff. A universal provider answered the rest. The figure is the latest count; the line shows each UTC day's end.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  100.0 * (parcels_own_adapter + parcels_other_adapter) / nullif(parcels, 0) as "Parcels answered directly"
from metrics.goals_daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Checks answered directly
panels.description: Share of the checks that answered (updated or unchanged) that a carrier's adapter served: the parcel's carrier, or the carrier it was handed to. A universal provider served the rest. The figure is today so far (UTC); the line shows each day.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  100.0 * direct_checks / nullif(answered_checks, 0) as "Checks answered directly"
from metrics.goals_daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Checks that failed
panels.description: Share of the checks that ended in error or were abandoned, out of those that ended updated, unchanged, waiting, error or abandoned. The figure is today so far (UTC); the line shows each day.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  100.0 * failed_checks / nullif(checks, 0) as "Checks that failed"
from metrics.goals_daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Stale parcels
panels.description: Share of the followed parcels being tracked with a scan that had no answered check in the 24 h before. Followed: parcels of accounts, and parcels without one that had a check in those 24 h. The figure is the latest count; the line shows each UTC day's end.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  100.0 * stale_parcels / nullif(followed_parcels, 0) as "Stale parcels"
from metrics.goals_daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Readers who say it's right
panels.description: Readers' answers over the past 7 days that say the parcel is right, as a share of all their answers, and how many answers there were. Few answers make the share swing. The figure is the latest count; the line shows each UTC day's end.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  100.0 * feedback_right_7d / nullif(feedback_7d, 0) as "Right",
  feedback_7d as "Answers"
from metrics.goals_daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Gap held by the top carriers
panels.description: Unfinished parcels with a scan whose latest answer came from a universal provider, and followed ones that went 24 h without an answer or whose checks fail, counted now; and the share of them the 5, 10 and 20 carriers with the most hold. A high share means fixing a few carriers closes most of the gap.

targets.rawSql:
select max(cumulative_percent) filter (where rank <= 5) as "Top 5",
  max(cumulative_percent) filter (where rank <= 10) as "Top 10",
  max(cumulative_percent) filter (where rank <= 20) as "Top 20",
  sum(parcels) as "Parcels in the gap"
from metrics.carrier_gaps

panels.title: Who answered unfinished parcels last
panels.description: Parcels being tracked with a scan at each UTC day's end, by who served their latest answered check: their own carrier's adapter, another carrier's (a handoff, or a carrier found for the number), or a universal provider. Unnamed provider: older checks did not record which one.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  parcels_own_adapter as "Own carrier's adapter",
  parcels_other_adapter as "Another carrier's adapter",
  parcels_parcelsapp as "ParcelsApp",
  parcels_17track as "17TRACK",
  parcels_ship24 as "Ship24",
  parcels_postal_ninja as "Postal Ninja",
  parcels_upu as "UPU",
  parcels_other_provider as "Unnamed provider"
from metrics.goals_daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Direct share, failures and staleness
panels.description: Each UTC day. Left axis: the share of parcels being tracked, and of answered checks, that a carrier's adapter answered. Right axis: the share of checks that failed, and of followed parcels with no answer for 24 h. Dashed lines count checks; solid lines count parcels.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  100.0 * (parcels_own_adapter + parcels_other_adapter) / nullif(parcels, 0) as "Parcels answered directly",
  100.0 * direct_checks / nullif(answered_checks, 0) as "Checks answered directly",
  100.0 * failed_checks / nullif(checks, 0) as "Checks that failed",
  100.0 * stale_parcels / nullif(followed_parcels, 0) as "Stale parcels"
from metrics.goals_daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Answered directly and failed, hourly
panels.description: Each hour, from Prometheus: the share of answered refreshes that a carrier's adapter served (left axis), and the share of all refreshes that ended in error (right axis). Hourly, to see a release land; the counters restart with each deploy. The carrier filter applies.

panels.title: Where the gap is
panels.description: Unfinished parcels with a scan whose latest answer came from a universal provider, and followed ones that went 24 h without an answer or whose checks fail, counted now: by the carrier that could take them, why it does not, and the lane where the fix belongs. Carriers with the most come first; Cumulative is the share of all such parcels that the carriers up to this rank hold.

targets.rawSql:
select rank, carrier, reason, lane, parcels, carrier_parcels, cumulative_percent
from metrics.carrier_gaps
order by rank, parcels desc, reason

panels.title: Readers who say it's right, 7 days
panels.description: At each UTC day's end: the share of readers' answers in the 7 days before that say the parcel is right (line, left axis), and how many answers there were (bars, right axis).

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  100.0 * feedback_right_7d / nullif(feedback_7d, 0) as "Right",
  feedback_7d as "Answers"
from metrics.goals_daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Scans no map read
panels.description: Of the scans stored each UTC day that record where their stage came from: the share no carrier map or wording rule read (Unmapped), and the share a wording rule read instead of a carrier map. Bars, on the right axis: wordings first collected as unmapped that day.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  100.0 * scans_unmapped / nullif(scans, 0) as "Unmapped",
  100.0 * scans_by_wording / nullif(scans, 0) as "Read by wording",
  new_unmapped_wordings as "New unmapped wordings"
from metrics.goals_daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Checks with an anomaly
panels.description: Share of the checks each UTC day that carry at least one anomaly code, out of those that ended updated, unchanged, waiting, error or abandoned. The Sync anomalies table below names the codes.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  100.0 * anomalous_checks / nullif(checks, 0) as "Checks with an anomaly"
from metrics.goals_daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Parcels showing a provider's copy
panels.description: Parcels being tracked with a scan that show a universal provider's copy of a carrier's scan: the same stage at the same second, or the same wording a whole number of quarter hours up to 14 h away. Counted live only, so days recorded after the fact are empty.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  copied_parcels as "Parcels showing a copy"
from metrics.goals_daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Lookups
panels.description: Carrier and provider lookups in the time range.

panels.title: Lookups lost
panels.description: Share of lookups that failed after every step. Answers about the number (not found, no history yet, missing or invalid input) are not failures.

panels.title: Fallbacks
panels.description: Recovery steps run after an earlier step failed.

panels.title: Refreshes
panels.description: Parcel refreshes in the time range, whoever served them.

panels.title: Refresh errors
panels.description: Share of refreshes that ended in error.

panels.title: Unmapped statuses
panels.description: Share of persisted events whose stage neither the carrier's map nor the wording classifier decided.

panels.title: Refresh outcomes
panels.description: Parcel refreshes per hour: updated (a new scan or stage), unchanged, waiting, error or superseded.

panels.title: Who served refreshes
panels.description: Updated and unchanged refreshes per hour by who answered: the carrier's adapter, another carrier's adapter, a universal provider, or nobody.

panels.title: Refreshes served by a universal provider
panels.description: Per configured carrier, in the time range. A carrier with its own adapter should stay near zero: every point above it is a direct failure followed by the router's cooldown. Universal-only carriers, such as unknown, read 100%.

targets.expr: (sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_refresh_total{carrier=~"$carrier", served_by="provider", outcome=~"updated|unchanged"}[$__range])) or sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_refresh_total{carrier=~"$carrier", outcome=~"updated|unchanged"}[$__range])) * 0) / (sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_refresh_total{carrier=~"$carrier", outcome=~"updated|unchanged"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Silent carriers
panels.description: Carriers with lookups in the last 7 days and none in the last 48 hours, whatever the time range or carrier filter. Silence isn't success: a carrier with active parcels and no lookups is worth a look.

panels.title: Routing signals
panels.description: What checks learnt that the catalog, detection or the adapters could act on, by signal, the parcel's carrier and the carrier the signal is about (uncatalogued: a name a provider gave). Postgres keeps each number in tracking_routing_signals for the hourly review.

panels.title: Sync anomalies
panels.description: Suspicious decisions of checks, by carrier and anomaly code. Each stays on its attempt in tracking_sync_attempts; none reaches Sentry.

panels.title: Health incidents
panels.description: Refresh, provider and direct-tracking incidents that opened (or still fail six hours on), recovered, or closed with no sample left. Open ones are also Sentry issues; the others are not.

panels.title: Verification abstentions
panels.description: Scheduled JD lookups whose browser matcher declined an unreadable puzzle. Counts remain in the database for 24 hours; these are neither successful lookups nor actionable outages. Other failures still alert.

targets.rawSql:
select hour as time, carrier as metric, abstentions
from metrics.verification_abstentions
where $__timeFilter(hour) and carrier ~ '^(${carrier:regex})$'
order by 1

panels.title: Status mapping source by carrier
panels.description: Persisted events in the time range by how their stage was decided: the carrier's map, the wording classifier, or neither. Unmapped events are new wording to review in tracking_status_observations.

targets.expr: round((sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier", stage_source="carrier_map"}[$__range])) and on (carrier) sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier"}[$__range])) > 0) or (sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier"}[$__range])) > 0) * 0)

round((sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier", stage_source="wording"}[$__range])) and on (carrier) sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier"}[$__range])) > 0) or (sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier"}[$__range])) > 0) * 0)

round((sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier", stage_source="none"}[$__range])) and on (carrier) sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier"}[$__range])) > 0) or (sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier"}[$__range])) > 0) * 0)

(sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier", stage_source="none"}[$__range])) or sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier"}[$__range])) * 0) / (sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_status_mapping_total{carrier=~"$carrier"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Unmapped status share
panels.description: Share of each carrier's events over the trailing 24 hours that no map or wording decided. Carriers with none are hidden. A rising line is new wording.

panels.title: Detection confidence
panels.description: Tracking-number detections served to clients in the time range, by confidence.

panels.title: Checksum rejections
panels.description: Parcels a carrier's own lookup confirmed although detection had left that carrier out on a failed check digit, by carrier and rule id. A rule that keeps counting has a wrong check digit.

panels.title: Provider postcode requests
panels.description: Whether relaying a provider's postcode request pays off: asked, supplied, then each lookup made with it.

panels.title: DPD app sessions
panels.description: DPD app sessions taken up at start, and openings that ended opened or failed, by what began them. Openings by lookup or refused mean lookups waited for one.

panels.title: Successful lookups by serving step
panels.description: Which step produced the result, per hour. A step that never serves can be removed; a direct step that never serves means the direct path is dead.

panels.title: Lookup outcomes
panels.description: Every lookup by how it ended, per hour.

panels.title: Lookups lost after every step
panels.description: Lookups that failed once every step was used, per hour, excluding answers about the number. Each one benches that adapter for the router's cooldown and sends the parcel to a universal provider.

panels.title: Lookups saved by a later step
panels.description: Successful lookups that needed more than one step attempt, per hour. For La Poste, final_step=retry with attempts 2, 3 or 4 is a 403 incident page recovered by the first, second or third retry; an attempts value that never appears is a retry that never helps.

targets.expr: sum by (carrier, final_step, attempts) (increase(carrier_lookup_total{carrier=~"$carrier", outcome="ok", attempts=~"[2-9]"}[1h]))

panels.title: Step failures
panels.description: Failed step attempts by carrier, step, error class and reason, per hour, including those a later step recovered. Answers about the number are left out.

panels.title: Fallbacks
panels.description: Recovery steps run after an earlier step failed, per hour, by reason. A rising count with successful lookups means a hidden regression of the direct path.

panels.title: Step p95 duration
panels.description: 95th percentile of one step attempt's duration over the past hour. Few attempts make it coarse: the histogram's buckets stop at 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 60 and 120 s.

panels.title: Direct-path success by carrier
panels.description: Share of direct step attempts that succeeded in the time range, worst first.

targets.expr: (sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_step_total{carrier=~"$carrier", step="direct", outcome="ok"}[$__range])) or sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_step_total{carrier=~"$carrier", step="direct"}[$__range])) * 0) / (sum by (carrier) (increase(carrier_step_total{carrier=~"$carrier", step="direct"}[$__range])) > 0)
